To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the tax system has an important impact on the financing and investment decisions of companies, (2) the impact of the tax system on investment and financing decisions is different for small and large firms and, (3) the tax system affects the financing and investment behavior of companies in different countries in the same way.

(a) firms are more sensitive to changes in the interest rates of the financial markets than to changes in tax rates, (b) the sensitivity to changes in the tax rates is larger for small firms than for larger firms, and (c) the sensitivity to the interest rates and tax rates is larger during recessions than during expansions.

the effects of the capital market imperfections on the investment and financial decisions of firms and the role of tax policy in these decisions.
